url.description: Canonical site URL, ending in a slash.

socialDescription.description: Description shown in LinkedIn/Slack link previews.

sections.description: Page sections in display order. Set enabled to false to hide one.

label.description: Nav link text, and the section heading unless heading is set.

heading.description: Optional section heading when it should differ from the nav label.

nav.description: Show a link to this section in the header nav.

tile.description: Show a card for this section in the button grid below the hero.

description.description: Card subtitle, used when no summary can be calculated from the content (e.g. About me).
